resources.string: Rings when an iClicker poll opens so you never miss the window. You tap Join yourself.
Watches for the iClicker poll popup and plays a sound/vibration so you can tap Join. It does not tap anything for you.
⚠️ Not active — tap below and enable \"Poll Alert watcher\"

Setup: tap \"Open accessibility settings\", find \"Poll Alert watcher\", and turn it on. Keep the iClicker app open during class. When a poll appears, your phone will ring/vibrate — look up and tap Join.
